tools.name: search_law
tools.description: Find articles of Lithuanian codes, laws and Government-approved rules (unofficial mirror of e-tar.lt). Use a reference ("DK 52", "CK 6.228¹", "KET 52", "GDPR 17", "2019/944 15", "Energetikos įstatymo 15 straipsnis") or Lithuanian words ("kasmetinės atostogos", also everyday ones: "alimentai"). Retur

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: The text of one article (or point) as published by the Seimas Chancellery, unchanged, with its status today (Galioja šiandien / Įsigalios D / Gali būti pasenęs / Neaišku, ar galioja / Neteko galios), until when that label is certain, amending acts, the future wording if adopted, defined terms used,

tools.name: find_definition
tools.description: Where a term is legally defined, in every act on the site: the term, its alias ("toliau – …"), the definition text, the act and article/part with a link, and the article's status today. Inflection-tolerant ("vartotojo objektas" = "vartotojo objektą"). The same word often means different things in di

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: Several articles (or points, or parts) in one call, up to 20: each as get_article returns it. Use it to read everything a search or `related` found, instead of one call per article.

tools.name: related
tools.description: References both ways for an article (or point, part, or a whole act): the articles it cites, and the articles of other acts, of the same act and the energy regulator's (VERT) decisions that cite it. E.g. which rules and decisions apply an article of a law. Each item has its status and URL; read them

tools.name: list_acts
tools.description: The acts on the site, 50 at a time: key, citation form, name, number of articles. Over 1,200 acts: give `query` (words of the name or a common name: "energetikos", "GDPR"). You rarely need this: search_law and get_article take an act's name, abbreviation, common name or EU number directly.

tools.name: get_act_contents
tools.description: The articles of one act in order (number, title, chapter, status), paged, and its annexes (read one with get_article: "6 priedas").

tools.name: search_votes
tools.description: Seimas votes (the Lithuanian parliament; preview): find votes by a draft number ('XVP-1885'), the number of the law a draft amends ('XIV-1381'), an act on this site ('DK', 'darbo kodeksas') or Lithuanian words of the agenda item. Newest first: when, what was voted on, for/against/abstain, the result

tools.name: get_vote
tools.description: One Seimas vote (an id from search_votes or mp_votes): what was voted on, the totals and every MP's choice (for, against, abstain), or why there are no individual votes.

tools.name: mp_votes
tools.description: How one MP voted: their recorded votes, optionally only on votes matching a query (draft, law number, act or words, as search_votes) and one choice; newest first, with counts.

tools.name: upcoming_changes
tools.description: Articles whose text or status changes in the next days (adopted amendments with a date).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_votes" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
